notes.title: Introducing Dawn Of Fear
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2886490/Dawn_Of_Fear/

Hello Everyone! We're finally introducing our new project called Dawn Of Fear! - One survival horror project which the player Experience an intense survival horror journey as a investigative agent in a dark and cursed village. The quest for a leader has never been so hindered.

5 MINUTES OF GAMEPLAY

[previewyoutube=tFshHOp--XQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is still in work in progress, so a lot of things will be changed.

GAME HIGHLIGHTS

- First Person Action Shooter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/01680096efabea145df308ec25ac0f695aa573d3.png

In this possessed village, there are a lot of cult followers, so stay safe!

- Huge Variety of Enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/e40ac9e0f927319e5625dd64b44e70deae1459af.png

From normal possessed villagers to some side bosses to the main enemies.

- Open world exploration with side puzzles (For each chapter)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/61ad41dc73e51665c04628cc81ab7a35d4bc30d3.png

For each chapter, the game will contain at least one open world scene including:
 - Side Bosses
 - Treasures
 - Optional Loot

RELEASING PLANS

We plan to release the game with 1 chapter only.
The other chapters will be available by DLC, so expect the price to be low for each part.

We'll discuss later about events so tune in our X/discord server here:

https://linktr.ee/blackhawkgames

- BHWK

notes.title: What's Up for 2021?! BlackHawk Games 2021 Dev Plan.

Hello Everyone!!

We've made this news to advice what's coming next on this year, and to clarify what is coming to NECROSIS : RECONFIGURATED on the next months.

HUGE ADVICE

On march, one integrant (Mazara) left the game company, and after that, we've got three new people to help us making the newest games that are coming up on this year, so expect us updating the games more frequent than the last times.

WHAT'S COMING ON THIS YEAR

This Year, We expect to launch one new game to our library, on the end of the year, since we want to make the best gameplay experience and not make the same mistake as the poor launch of the game NECROSIS : RECONFIGURATED.

HOW ABOUT NECROSIS SERIES ?!

In this year, we are announcing that NECROSIS 2021 is officially cancelled, because we want to improve the game NECROSIS : RECONFIGURATED the best as we can, now that we have one animator on the roster.
